- **10 EMA:** It has fallen every day in the window (2417.78 on 10-24 to 1777.87). Price sits about 66 below it. A reclaim of the 10 EMA would be the first sign the bounce is gaining traction. Until then it acts as a ceiling.
- **50 SMA:** It is declining steadily, from 2546.42 on 10-24 to 2225.75. It fell about 20 points on the latest day.
- **200 SMA:** It is flat-to-slightly-lower (about 2159 on 10-29, 2119.37 now), falling about 3 points per day.
- **Death-cross watch:** The 50 SMA is still above the 200 SMA, but the gap is only about 106 points. It has been closing at roughly 17 points per day recently. If that pace held, a bearish 50/200 cross could occur within a couple of weeks. This is an extrapolation, not a forecast, and the pace will change as older values drop out of the window. A death cross is a lagging confirmation and would arrive after a roughly 40% decline.

- **Interpretation:** Oversold readings are not buy signals by themselves in a persistent downtrend. RSI was capped around 40 for most of the window, which is a bearish-regime pattern.   - 1.5× ATR is about 166 points.
